paper-miningcraft.title: Paper Miningcraft: Play Free Online - Build and Explore!
paper-miningcraft.description: Dive into Paper Miningcraft, a 2D reimagining of the classic sandbox game. Gather resources, craft tools, and build your world! Enjoy Paper Miningcraft online for free and start your adventure today!

HomeIframe.title: Paper Miningcraft
HomeIframe.description: Paper Miningcraft is a 2D version of the popular sandbox game. Play now in your browser!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Paper Miningcraft is an online 2D version of the popular sandbox game Minecraft made by Mojang Studios. Select a game mode, skin, and explore a blocky pixelated world just like in Minecraft.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: WASD or arrow keys to move, jump, or swim
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Left-click to dig or place blocks
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: E to open inventory or chest
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience the familiar world of Minecraft in a unique 2D perspective.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Choose from Survival, Peaceful, and Creative modes to suit your playstyle.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Explore numerous custom maps designed by other players.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Utilize a wide array of tools, options, and resources to build and survive.
